[1] Location: ISIR (Institut des Systemes Intelligents et de Robotique), CNRS / Sorbonne Universite, Paris, France.

[2] Job Titles:
- PhD Position 1: GenAI as Cognitive Support -- Tools for Thought
- PhD Position 2: New Interaction Paradigms for GenAI Systems

[3] Requirements:
We seek candidates with a strong background in Human-Computer Interaction, Human-Centered AI, or a closely related field. Candidates should have experience with user research and/or system design, and an interest in empirical and design-oriented research. Some experience with AI/ML tools or systems is a plus but not required. The working language of the lab and supervision is English.

PhD 1 -- Tools for Thought:
This project investigates how GenAI systems can support and extend human cognition rather than replace it. Research questions include:
under what conditions does GenAI support reasoning rather than displace it; how can systems use friction, expose unfinished, incomplete results; and how should cognitive support be evaluated beyond task completion. The work combines system design, interaction research, and empirical studies.

PhD 2 -- New Interaction Paradigms for GenAI Systems:
This project rethinks fundamental interaction paradigms for systems in which GenAI functions as both a medium and a material. Research questions include: how can interaction languages move beyond linear chat dialogs; how do these new interaction paradigms shape user cognition and agency; and what new media emerges when GenAI mediates input and output. The work spans interaction design, systems engineering, and empirical studies.

Both positions are funded through the EDITE doctoral school (ED-130) at Sorbonne Universite, starting Fall 2026. Supervision will be provided by Gonzalo Ramos and Baptiste Caramiaux.
